entries.failure_mode: Vitreous pitfall primarily concerns 'sample presence and collection contamination' rather than annotation: downgrade if any of the three questions (collection method/control/cell count) cannot be clearly answered
entries.observable_signature: Cassette washing vs. membrane stripping, presence of paired blood/control eye missing from specimen records
entries.mitigation: Before analyzing vitreous, answer three questions: collection method (cassette washing/recycling fluid vs. vitrectomy membrane stripping), presence of control eye/paired blood, total cell count and cells per eye—downgrade to descriptive report if any is unclear.

entries.failure_mode: Three sources of collection contamination: retinal avulsion fragments (photoreceptors/RPE), membrane tissue inclusion, intraoperative bleeding
entries.observable_signature: Photoreceptor/RPE signature in vitreous samples = collection flag, not new discovery
entries.mitigation: Photoreceptor/RPE signature in vitreous samples = collection flag, not new discovery; blood depletion method same as membrane domain (PBMC pairing); specimens lacking collection method documentation excluded from omics conclusion pool.
